question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Redundant
solution: The correct answer is '**Superfluous**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Redundant**' is '**Superfluous**'. • **Redundant**: (used about employees) no longer needed for a job and therefore out of work. [(कर्मचारी) गै़र-ज़रूरी और इसलिए बेकार, फ़ालतू, अतिरिक्त] • *Example: When the factory closed 800 people were made **redundant**.* • **Superfluous**: more than is wanted; not needed. (अपेक्षित से अधिक, अतिरिक्त या फ़ालतू; अनावश्‍यक) • *Example: My presence at the afternoon's proceedings was **superfluous**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Superfluous.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Arrogant**: thinking that you are better and more important than other people. (अक्‍खड़, घमंडी, अभिमानी) • **Essential**: completely necessary; that you must have or do. (परमावश्‍यक; सर्वथा अपेक्षित) • **Ignorant**: not knowing about something. [(किसी बात से) अनजान, अनभिज्ञ] 3d:Tcf2, The correct answer is '**Appeal**'.
